title: Zesty Silky Moroccan Lentils Msemen
description: Savory and silky Moroccan dish featuring puy lentils, beurre monte, and wrapped in msemen, perfect for a festive meal.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil and add the puy lentils, reducing heat to low and simmering for 20 minutes or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, cooking for 1 minute to allow the spices to bloom.
Add the cooked lentils to the skillet, stirring to combine with the spice mixture.
Stir in the beurre monte until well combined and the lentil mixture is silky and smooth.
Lay a sheet of msemen dough on a flat surface and spoon about 1/2 cup of the lentil mixture onto the center of the dough.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a square shape, pressing the edges together to seal the msemen.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Cook the msemen in a large skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
